svg.title: Contact Was Not the Same as Submission
svg.desc: Modern teaching cards: Connection: Contact and resistance can occur in the same history.. Question: Ask who maintained decisions about local affairs.. Limit: An exchange alone does not prove total submission or equal power within a community.
